question: Where can I find a park within 100 kilometers, oriented toward the south of Shavers Creek Environmental Center, Petersburg, PA?
sql: SELECT park_name FROM parks WHERE ST_DWithin( geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry::geography FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Shavers Creek Environmental Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Petersburg%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ), 100000 ) AND degrees( ST_Azimuth( ST_Centroid( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Shavers Creek Environmental Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Petersburg%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ) ), ST_Centroid(geometry) ) ) BETWEEN 157.5 AND 202.5;
